financials.hidden_costs: Hostel & Mess approx ₹80,000/yr

placements.reality_check: Incredible brand value and alumni network. Placements are heavily skewed by top international offers, but even median is superb.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Extremely competitive but highly rewarding. Massive campus in the heart of South Delhi.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: The best you can get in NCR. Pressure is high but the tag stays for life.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹60,000/yr

placements.reality_check: Top branches get 20+, lower branches struggle slightly more but still decent.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Huge campus, very active tech and cultural societies.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Great ROI if you have Delhi quota, but batch sizes are massive now.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹65,000/yr

placements.reality_check: Historically incredible for CS/IT placements, rivaling some IITs.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Strict attendance compared to DTU, but excellent coding culture.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: If you want pure tech placements, NSUT is often preferred over DTU.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹80,000/yr

placements.reality_check: Exceptional placements, often surpassing DTU/NSUT, but coursework is famously brutal.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Research-focused, immense academic pressure, extremely modern infrastructure.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Take it if you genuinely love CS. Don't take it just for placements if you want an easy college life.

colleges.name: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW)

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹50,000/yr

placements.reality_check: One of the highest placement-to-cutoff ratios in the country due to diversity hiring drives by FAANG.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Safe, supportive, but campus is relatively small.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Unbelievable ROI for female candidates. Diversity hiring makes placements exceptional.

financials.hidden_costs: Mandatory fully residential. Total cost approx 20L for 4 years.

placements.reality_check: Very good for a private university. Backed by HCL, so tech placements are solid.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Beautiful, massive residential campus. Multidisciplinary approach.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: One of the best private universities in NCR if you can afford it. Better peer group than Amity.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹1,00,000/yr

placements.reality_check: Consistent IT placements. Strict academic environment.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Known to be strict (school-like) with high focus on attendance and exams.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Good fallback if you miss out on DTU/NSUT, but campus life is strict.

financials.hidden_costs: Fully residential. Total cost can exceed 40L, but extremely generous financial aid exists.

placements.reality_check: Not an engineering college. Best for Economics, CS, Liberal Arts. Top consulting/finance placements.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Ivy-league style liberal arts culture. Incredible peer group and faculty.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: If you want a liberal arts approach to CS or Econ, it's the best in India. Very expensive without aid.

financials.hidden_costs: Very affordable. Low cost of living.

placements.reality_check: Service-based mass recruiters mostly. You have to hustle off-campus for top tech jobs.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Standard state university life. Very politically active campus.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: A solid safety net for Haryana/NCR students with lower ranks, but don't expect spoon-fed placements.

financials.hidden_costs: High living expenses if participating in the social culture.

placements.reality_check: Massive batch sizes. Top 10% get great packages, the rest get mass recruiters.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Incredible infrastructure and high social life. 'Work hard, play hard' applies if you stay focused.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: You can have a great career if you ignore the distractions. Easy to get in, hard to stand out.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel is cheap but hard to get.

placements.reality_check: Top-notch placements in both IT and core sectors. Huge alumni base.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Iconic campus, massive clubs (like Baja SAE), highly driven peer group.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: The absolute best state college in Maharashtra. Almost impossible to get in without top scores.

financials.hidden_costs: Pune cost of living.

placements.reality_check: Unbelievable coding culture. Placements rival or beat COEP for purely CS/IT roles.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Very small campus, school-like strictness, but insanely competitive coding environment.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: If you just want to code and get a 15+ LPA job, PICT is the place. Don't expect a fun campus life.

financials.hidden_costs: Standard Pune living costs.

placements.reality_check: Solid mid-tier placements. Good mix of core and IT.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Balanced life. Good clubs, decent campus, but not as intense as COEP/PICT.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: A great balance of academics, placements, and college life in Pune.

financials.hidden_costs: High living costs if participating in social life.

placements.reality_check: Good for CS, but very large batch sizes mean high competition internally.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Beautiful campus, massive crowds, known for strong cultural events.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Very expensive. Good if you can afford it and stay away from distractions.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹1.5L/yr

placements.reality_check: Decent placements, heavily leaning on the strong Symbiosis brand name.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Excellent campus at Lavale. Very cosmopolitan peer group.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Great campus life and decent academics. It's expensive but provides a premium experience.

admission.process: Special Counseling for Wards of Army Personnel

financials.hidden_costs: Mandatory Hostel.

placements.reality_check: Incredible placements. Companies love the disciplined mindset of the students.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Strict, disciplined, high focus on sports and academics.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: If your parent is in the Army, this is an absolute hidden gem. Better ROI than most private colleges.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹60,000/yr

placements.reality_check: Legacy institute (Kalpana Chawla's alma mater). Phenomenal alumni network and top tech placements.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Beautiful campus in Sector 12, great city to live in, balanced college life.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Often preferred over newer NITs due to its legacy, location, and alumni network.

colleges.name: University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET, PU)

financials.hidden_costs: Low costs overall.

placements.reality_check: Good ROI. Top students grab excellent off-campus offers.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Located inside Panjab University. Incredibly vibrant student politics and culture.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Great exposure because of PU's diverse campus. Academics are average but peer group is good.

colleges.name: Chandigarh College of Engineering and Technology (CCET)

financials.hidden_costs: Very affordable.

placements.reality_check: Mostly mass recruiters, but the degree holds value as it's affiliated to PU.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Small campus, strict academics, not much college life compared to UIET.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Good backup if you want to stay in Chandigarh and want an affordable government degree.

admission.cutoff_general_estimate: Easy to get in, CUCET gives scholarships.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹1,20,000/yr

placements.reality_check: Extreme mass recruiter hub. They bring hundreds of companies, but batch size is enormous (10,000+ engineers).

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Huge diverse campus, very vibrant, students from all over India and Africa.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: You will get placed, but you have to fight thousands of others to get a package above 10 LPA.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel is mandatory for many courses.

placements.reality_check: Known for having slightly better academic rigor and placements per capita than Chandigarh University.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Strict rules (almost school-like), high focus on attendance.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Better academics and discipline than CU, making it a slightly better choice for serious students.

financials.hidden_costs: Total cost for 4 years is around 35-40 Lakhs. Need-based scholarships available.

placements.reality_check: Founded by tech CEOs and VC leaders. Extremely strong industry connect.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Like Ashoka, but for Tech and Engineering. Heavy focus on entrepreneurship.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: A massive hidden gem if you can afford it. It's building the 'Stanford of India' model.

financials.hidden_costs: Hostel approx ₹1,00,000/yr

placements.reality_check: One of the best CS colleges in India. Known for its iMTech (5-year integrated) course.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Located in Electronic City. Heavy academic workload, lots of research and projects.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Unbelievable placements. Choose this over lower-tier IITs if you strictly want a tech career.

admission.cutoff_general_estimate: Top 1000 in COMEDK, Top 300 in KCET

financials.hidden_costs: Management quota fees can go up to 10-15 Lakhs per year.

placements.reality_check: Best private engineering college in Bangalore. Excellent placements across branches.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Strict academics (85% attendance rule usually heavily enforced), highly competitive.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Academically exhausting but the placements justify the grind.

financials.hidden_costs: Similar to RVCE, management quota is highly expensive.

placements.reality_check: Second only to RVCE in Bangalore. Very strong alumni network.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Great location (Basavanagudi), more relaxed than RVCE, better college life.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Many prefer BMS over RVCE simply because the campus life is far better while placements are almost similar.

financials.hidden_costs: Very expensive compared to VTU colleges unless you get KCET quota.

placements.reality_check: Phenomenal CS placements. They focus heavily on coding and algorithms.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Known as a 'school'. Very strict, frequent exams, high pressure.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: You will get placed well, but you will have absolutely no social life for 4 years.

financials.hidden_costs: Living in Mathikere is slightly expensive.

placements.reality_check: Consistent IT placements. Completes the 'top 3' trio of Bangalore (RV, BMS, MSRIT).

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Great infrastructure, very active student clubs, good balance of fun and studies.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: A solid, safe, reliable choice for engineering in Bangalore.

admission.cutoff_general_estimate: Top 8000-12000 in COMEDK depending on branch

financials.hidden_costs: Management quota is heavily promoted.

placements.reality_check: Good placements for CS/IT, but batch sizes are very large.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Huge campus shared with multiple other institutes, very diverse crowd.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Good fallback college in Bangalore if you miss the top 3.

financials.hidden_costs: Located in the heart of the city, so living costs can vary.

placements.reality_check: Decent placements, primarily service-based IT companies with some core.

vibe_and_culture.student_life: Very small campus, basically a few buildings. Lack of open grounds.
vibe_and_culture.reddit_verdict: Choose it only for placements and central location. Don't expect a 'campus life'.
